Docs.summary: Provides custom audience data, request builders, and managers for Android ad selection.

remarks.para: Use to join or leave an audience, fetch an audience from a buyer's server, or schedule a deferred update. Request objects carry the audience identifiers, bidding data, and optional caller-supplied fields needed by these operations.
can replace remote bidding data with local values for testing. These test operations require a debuggable application and enabled developer options.
The operations and test requirements are documented in the CustomAudienceManager reference and the TestCustomAudienceManager reference.
